# LuauDocs

> Documentation generator for Luau.

This file indexes the project for coding agents reading a local copy of it, in the llms.txt format: its guides, then every module, type, and member its Luau source exposes. Links are relative to this file, and each API entry links the lines that declare it, directly below its doc comment.

Keep it current: after changing the public surface, a doc comment, or a guide, run `npx luaudocs@0.3.0 llms` in this directory and commit the result. When nothing listed here changed, the command leaves the file as it is.

## Guides

- [Getting Started](.luaudocs/guide/getting-started.md): Install LuauDocs and build a browsable documentation site for your Luau library.
- [How It Works](.luaudocs/guide/how-it-works.md): How LuauDocs finds your public surface and organizes your documentation site.
- [Writing Doc Comments](.luaudocs/guide/writing-doc-comments.md): Write prose descriptions and automatic symbol cross-references for your Luau API.
- [Overriding with Tags](.luaudocs/guide/overriding-with-tags.md): Override inferred types, placement, visibility, and badges with Moonwave-compatible tags.
- [Configuration](.luaudocs/guide/configuration.md): Configure luaudocs.toml, understand file ownership, and style your site with custom.css.
- [Deploying](.luaudocs/guide/deploying.md): Publish your documentation site to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages with base paths and custom domains.
- [Coding Agents](.luaudocs/guide/coding-agents.md): Generate a repository-root llms.txt index with file and line links for coding agents.
- [Migrating from Moonwave](.luaudocs/guide/migrating-from-moonwave.md): Convert a Moonwave project, including hand-written guides and assets, in one command.
- [CLI](.luaudocs/guide/reference/cli.md): Every luaudocs command and flag.
- [Tags](.luaudocs/guide/reference/tags.md): Complete reference for all 24 Moonwave-compatible override tags in LuauDocs.
- [Markup](.luaudocs/guide/reference/markup.md): Admonitions, tabs, frames, badges, and inline highlighting in doc comments and guide pages.
- [Diagnostics](.luaudocs/guide/reference/diagnostics.md): Every diagnostic code LuauDocs emits and how each severity affects your build.
- [Doc Model](.luaudocs/guide/reference/doc-model.md): Export the JSON doc model that LuauDocs extracts from your source and use it in your own tooling.
- [Troubleshooting](.luaudocs/guide/reference/troubleshooting.md): Fix environment and build failures that occur outside source-level diagnostics.

## Flux

- [Flux](examples/Flux/init.luau): A tiny reactive state library.
- [`Flux.State: State`](examples/Flux/State.luau): [Module]
- [`Flux.Util: Util`](examples/Flux/Util/init.luau): [Module]
- [`Flux.state<T>(initial: T?): State.State<T>`](examples/Flux/init.luau#L18-L20): Creates a state holding `initial`.
- [`Flux.isState(value: any): boolean`](examples/Flux/State.luau#L20-L22): [from State] Reports whether `value` is a state.

## Flux.State

- [State](examples/Flux/State.luau): A single reactive value, and the listeners watching it. Constructors: `Flux.state`, `State.new`.
- [`type State<T>`](examples/Flux/State.luau#L6-L12): A value that notifies listeners whenever it changes.
- [`State.new<T>(initial: T?): State<T>`](examples/Flux/State.luau#L15-L17): Creates a state holding `initial`.
- [`State.isState(value: any): boolean`](examples/Flux/State.luau#L20-L22): Reports whether `value` is a state.
- [`State:Connect(callback: (any) -> ()): () -> ()`](examples/Flux/State.luau#L29-L37): Runs `callback` whenever the value changes.
- [`State:Destroy()`](examples/Flux/State.luau#L44-L46): [Deprecated since 2.0: states are collected once nothing references them] Drops every listener and releases the state.

## Flux.Util

- [Util](examples/Flux/Util/init.luau): Small helpers that stand on their own.
- [`Util.Queue: Queue`](examples/Flux/Util/Queue.luau): [Module]

## Flux.Util.Queue

- [Queue](examples/Flux/Util/Queue.luau): A queue that yields on `pop` until something is available. Constructors: `Queue.new`.
- [`type Queue<T>`](examples/Flux/Util/Queue.luau#L6-L11): A first-in, first-out queue.
- [`Queue.new<T>(): Queue<T>`](examples/Flux/Util/Queue.luau#L14-L16): Creates an empty queue.
- [`Queue:push(item: any)`](examples/Flux/Util/Queue.luau#L23-L25): [since 1.1.0] Adds `item` to the back of the queue.
- [`Queue:pop(): any`](examples/Flux/Util/Queue.luau#L28-L33): [Yields] Removes the front item and returns it, waiting when the queue is empty.
